_source: Story 055, decision D-065. Exploration ambience per room theme (keys of data/world/themes.json), played by Ambience (src/audio/ambience.gd) under the music. folder: where the sounds live (made by tools/audio/synth_v2.py). bed: a 20 s loop always under the room, bed_db its level. oneshots: sounds that happen now and then, each with a weight (how often it is picked against the others); every_s: seconds between them, picked at random in the range; oneshot_db: their level, varied by up to oneshot_spread_db quieter, as if near or far. fade_s: crossfade when the theme changes.
